issue.title: Make post-commit agent publication survive sidecar commits and unpublishable hoods
issue.description: A `sase commit` inside an SDD sidecar checkout publishes to the sidecar's host project instead of failing after the commit already landed, and a publication request that can never be satisfied is retired with a recorded reason instead of cycling through quarantine forever.

issue.title: Resolve the publication project from the committed repository path
issue.description: target-resolution: resolve the post-commit publication target by matching the commit's repository path against the repo inventory (including workspace clones) so sidecar and linked-repo commits publish to the host project, and stop the auxiliary publication step from failing a commit that already landed.

issue.title: Retire publication requests that can never be published
issue.description: terminal-disposition: add a durable terminal disposition to the publication outbox, classify "hood has no publishable runs" as terminal once a retry has confirmed it, and stop `--retry-quarantined` from resurrecting terminal requests into an endless quarantine cycle.

issue.title: Operator surface for retired requests and residue cleanup
issue.description: unpublishable-surface: expose retired requests through `sase agent sync`, `sase doctor`, and the post-commit warning with accurate remediation, and purge the three residue requests currently stuck in this machine's sase outbox.

fields.notes: [2026-07-28T18:45:29Z · sase-ah.2] Implemented publication-outbox schema v3 with durable terminal/terminal_reason state and schema-1/2 compatibility; confirmed terminal failures retire only after the same prior error, terminal requests are excluded from active work and quarantine retries, and drop_terminal_agent_publications returns/removes retired entries. Wired no-publishable-runs and full-sync materialization failures into terminal classification. Verification: 36 focused tests passed; full suite 23136 passed, 7 skipped; formatting, Ruff, mypy, script lint, toobig, and committed-plan validation passed. Required just check was run but its Symvision and SASE-validation stages are blocked by unrelated checkout/plan-sidecar issues: cross-file private _PlanProvenanceSection imports and missing prompt reverse links on agent_publication_reliability.md and bead_pages.md.

payload.close_reason: Implemented and verified durable retirement of terminal publication requests

fields.notes: [2026-07-28T19:17:57Z · sase-ah.3] unpublishable-surface landed: added `sase agent sync -d/--drop-retired` (rejected with --check like -q), retired-aware diagnostics in publication_quarantine_diagnostics (drop command for retired, retry command for quarantined), doctor now reports retired requests separately with the drop remediation, the post-commit warning names the drop command for retired backlogs, and the chats catalog/TUI gained a 'retired' publication disposition. Verified: just check clean for fmt/lint/symvision; full pytest green (3 unrelated flakes pass in isolation); just test-visual 365 passed. Residue purge: the gh_sase-org__sase outbox now holds no k4/lt/lz requests — lz was confirmed terminal and removed with `sase agent sync -d -p sase`, a later `sase agent sync -q -p sase` did not resurrect it, and sase doctor reports OK. Notes: `sase init skills --check` is red until the sase_chats skill-source change is committed and deployed per the commit-first-then-deploy rule; `plan links validate` was already failing on master. Follow-up observed while purging: the full-sync 'did not materialize' reason and the commit-path 'no publishable runs' reason alternate on a busy machine, which keeps resetting the terminal-confirmation chain so a request quarantines instead of retiring.

payload.close_reason: Retired-request operator surface (sync flag, doctor, post-commit warning, chats disposition) landed and the outbox residue is purged.
